frases.texto: This book offers comprehensive, self-contained knowledge on mobile edge computing (MEC)
This book provides basic concepts of MEC, explores the promising application scenarios of MEC integrated with emerging technologies
detailing the design and implementation of communications, computing, and caching in MEC

Supernet optimization involves training a single, over-parameterized network that encompasses the search space of all possible network architectures

This paper reviews the advance in design technologies for fiber-reinforced composite structures, including prediction and optimization methods for composite properties
This paper reviews
the rapid development of intelligent technology, such as big data, deep learning, and machine learning, has promoted the development of design technology

This scoping review maps composite evaluation approaches used to assess architecture-relevant software or system artifacts, including software architectures where applicable, on resource-constrained hardware
This scoping review
including explicit objective functions, benchmark-guided system-level modeling, structured qualitative trade-off assessment, and Quality-of-Experience (QoE)-oriented evaluation
representative studies such as FLASH, HW-FlowQ, Monarch, and ILLIXR illustrate related but distinct evaluation forms
Dataset pruning has emerged as a critical data-centric approach to optimize deep learning training by identifying and retaining the most informative samples while reducing computational burden
This review presents a recent analysis of dataset pruning techniques
The approaches presented have been divided into four distinct taxonomic categories: instance-based selection, coreset-based methods, difficulty-based pruning, and uncertainty-guided techniques
dataset pruning can achieve 40-80% data reduction while maintaining diagnostic accuracy within 2-5% of full dataset performance
Network quantization is arguably one of the most practical network compression approaches for reducing the enormous resource consumption of modern deep neural networks
we propose QwT-v2
By adopting a very lightweight channel-wise affine compensation (CWAC) module, QwT-v2 introduces significantly less extra parameters and computations
The compensation module of QwT-v2 can be integrated into quantization inference engines with little effort
In hierarchical text classification, we perform a sequence of inference steps to predict the category of a document from top to bottom of a given class taxonomy
we propose an auxiliary synthetic task of bottom-up-classification
We first define the task as a sequence-to-sequence problem
we retrieve textual definitions for the classes of all the hierarchy's layers, and map them into the word vector space
This survey comprehensively reviews a crucial subset of DA techniques, namely Mix-based Data Augmentation (MixDA), which generates novel samples by combining multiple examples
This survey comprehensively reviews
We begin by introducing a novel taxonomy that categorizes MixDA into Mixup-based, Cutmix-based, and mixture approaches
MixDA has penetrated a wide range of applications
Balseiro, Besbes, and Pizarro introduce a unifying model for a large class of dynamic optimization problems dubbed dynamic resource-constrained reward collection (DRC2) problems
Surveying the literature, they show that this class encompasses a variety of disparate and classical problems
they establish that the DRC2 class is amenable to analysis by characterizing the performance of a central, certainty-equivalent heuristic
In supervised machine learning, specifically in classification tasks, selecting and analyzing the feature vector to achieve better results is one of the most important tasks
we proposed a novel framework topic2features (T2F)
we leveraged unsupervised topic modelling LDA (Latent dirichlet allocation) approach to retrieve the topic distributions employed in supervised learning algorithms
The results show that our framework performs significantly better in terms of classification performance compared to the baseline
Driver drowsiness is a leading cause of road traffic fatalities worldwide, and the convergence of computer vision and deep learning has transformed driver-state monitoring
This systematic literature review, conducted using the PRISMA 2020 methodology and the Kitchenham protocol, synthesizes findings from 33 peer-reviewed studies
The literature is dominated by convolutional single–pass designs
no reviewed model combines an accuracy above 99% with a latency below 100 ms, and none were evaluated on embedded or automotive–grade hardware
Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a powerful tool for data science researchers, and it has been successfully applied to data mining and machine learning community
we give a detailed survey on existing NMF methods
a comprehensive analysis of their design principles, characteristics and drawbacks
we evaluate the performance of nine NMF methods through numerical experiments
Micro-ROS extends ROS capabilities to resource-constrained devices like ESP32, enabling seamless integration into robotic systems
This paper compares micro-ROS with classic ROS 2
Future plans include evaluating micro-ROS on a mobile robot platform for performance and efficiency
Federated Learning (FL) addresses these issues by allowing devices to train models locally and upload parameters to a central server without sharing local data
This survey provides a comprehensive summary of methods to improve communication efficiency in FL

focusing on: 1) minimizing communication complexity to reduce total transmission volume, 2) scheduling resources appropriately to improve training efficiency, 3) utilizing over-the-air computation (OTA)
Autoregression in large language models (LLMs) has shown impressive scalability by unifying all language tasks into the next token prediction paradigm
In this survey, we review the recent advances and discuss future directions for autoregressive vision foundation models
we categorize autoregressive vision foundation models from their vision tokenizers and autoregression backbones
A collection of related resources is available at https://github.com/EmmaSRH/ARVFM
Systems research on machine learning (ML) inference servers is an emerging field, often dependent on benchmarking
We propose Fafnir, a benchmarking tool

Fafnir is easy to use yet flexible enough to benchmark complex scenarios in addition to standard scenarios that involve, for example, commonly used Poisson or fixed interarrival time request distributions
This paper reviews concepts, modeling approaches, and recent findings along a spectrum of different levels of abstraction of neural network models including generalization
This paper reviews
Transfer learning approaches and results for (3) domain generalization are summarized
transformer-based foundation models
With the advancement of communication technology, Internet of Things (IoT) enabled smart home (SH) applications have engrossed substantial attention
In this paper, a long range (LoRa) based SH system is proposed
An AI-based data flow system for IoT server and cloud is also presented in this paper

This paper presents a comprehensive review to highlight the recent improvements in AL techniques
We employed adversarial learning techniques (AL) to add fake data into the model to ensure that the trained model was correct
The increasing deployment of distributed sensor networks in smart indoor environments has intensified the need for energy-efficient embedded system design
This paper presents a method-focused review of integration approaches for distributed sensors
The review examines existing methodologies along two primary dimensions, namely communication protocols and energyefficient wake-sleep mechanisms
Recent advancements in deep learning have significantly enhanced the automation of cervical cancer detection and segmentation by enabling precise analysis of cytology and histopathological images
This review highlights key trends including hybrid architectures, multi-scale feature extraction, and optimization-driven designs
Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have demonstrated superior capabilities in feature extraction, classification, and segmentation
Advanced segmentation models such as U-Net, Mask R-CNN, and DeepLab are widely used for accurate identification
The automotive industry has undergone a revolutionary transformation with the integration of embedded systems
This global review explores the evolution of embedded systems in the automotive sector
These systems, ranging from Engine Control Units (ECUs) to Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), have become pivotal
Generative AI (GAI) can enhance the cognitive, reasoning, and planning capabilities of intelligent modules in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV)
In this survey, we explore the integration of MoE and GAI to enable Artificial General Intelligence in IoV
the mixture of experts (MoE) can enable the distributed and collaborative execution of AI models
applications in IoV, including distributed perception and monitoring, collaborative decision-making and planning, and generative modeling and simulation
Reinforcement Learning is commonly used to train large language models using environmental feedback
We introduce a training framework, Self-Review Reinforcement Learning
the model generates a self-review to identify what went wrong, which conditions an improved second attempt
We evaluate SRRL against a standard RLVR baseline using the GRPO optimizer across two language models, Qwen 3-4B and OLMo-3- 7B, on GSM8K benchmark

Smart waste management and smart sewage monitoring are critical application areas where Internet of Things (IoT) technologies enable real-time sensing, remote monitoring, and data-driven decision-making
This paper presents a systematic literature review of lightweight IoT architectures for integrated smart waste and smart sewage monitoring systems

The review analyzes recent advancements in embedded hardware platforms, communication protocols, edge-fog-cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies including TinyML, Federated Learning, Digital Twins, and Green IoT
To address the labeled data scarcity and high complexity of GNNs, Knowledge Distillation (KD) has been introduced to enhance existing GNNs
This survey offers a comprehensive overview of Graph-based Knowledge Distillation methods

This paper first introduces the background of graph and KD. It then provides a comprehensive summary of three types of Graph-based Knowledge Distillation methods, namely Graph-based Knowledge Distillation for deep neural networks (DKD), Graph-based Knowledge Distillation for GNNs (GKD), and Self-Knowledge Distillation based Graph-based Knowledge Distillation (SKD)
We have also released related resources at https://github.com/liujing1023/Graph-based-Knowledge-Distillation

The factorization of such an HDI matrix can embed the involved entities into the low-dimensional feature space for acquiring their principal representation, which is a vital task in various application scenes and is often established through the Latent Factor Analysis (LFA)
This paper provides a comprehensive review of the existing parallel optimization algorithms for the LFA model
a parallel optimization algorithm is desired for raising the scalability and time efficiency of an LFA model
To identify the key factors and create the landscape of cybersecurity for embedded systems (CSES), an analytical review of the existing research on CSES has been conducted
This study provides a clear landscape of CSES
A Multiple Layers Feedback Framework of Embedded System Cybersecurity (MuLFESC) with nine layers of protection is proposed, with new metrics of risk assessment
the further enhancement of deep learning models for medical image analysis faces a significant challenge due to the scarcity of large, well-annotated datasets
This paper conducts a thorough review of data-efficient deep learning methods for medical image analysis

We categorize these methods based on the level of supervision they rely on, encompassing categories such as no supervision, inexact supervision, incomplete supervision, inaccurate supervision, and only limited supervision
There is continuous intensive research on image compression techniques in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) in the literature
in this paper, a review and analysis of image compression techniques and approaches in WSNs are conducted

Some of the image compression techniques in WSNs that exist in the literature include discrete cosine transform (DCT), discrete waveform transforms (DWT), set partitioning in a hierarchical tree (SPIHT), and embedded zero tree wavelet (EZW) coding
a rate-distortion balanced data compression algorithm with error bound mechanism based on artificial neural networks (ANN) in the form of an autoencoder (AE) was coded and simulated in MATLAB
